title: Arabella in the AI chase scene, ending on the Ivy logo

segments.text: I'm thinking of an idea where we have Arabella in this really interesting fight scene that I saw on Higgs Field AI.
It'd be great to find that video.
Use Arabella's character to run that chase, to jump over things.
Ivy, if you're able to put a little reminder in there.

Arabella runs through that scene. She jumps, she pushes away from people. It's a really cool AI scene, but using Arabella instead of the original performer in the actual video. When she gets to the end she has Ivy in her hand and says into the mic, "it's done." Then it goes to the Ivy branding logo.

cards.title: Arabella runs the AI chase scene
cards.gist: Recreate the fight/chase scene spotted on Higgs Field AI with Arabella's character running, jumping and pushing past people in place of the original performer.
cards.their_idea: An AI-generated fight/chase scene on Higgs Field AI featuring the original performer.
cards.her_take: Swap in Arabella's character and have her run the whole chase.

cards.title: Ending beat: "it's done" into logo
cards.gist: At the end of the chase Arabella holds Ivy, says "it's done" into the mic, and it cuts to the Ivy branding logo.

loose_ends.text: Find the fight/chase video seen on Higgs Field AI.

requests.text: Put a reminder in to get milk.
